---
title: "Custom Language Compiler"
subtitle: "A compiler and AST engine built from scratch in C/C++ with Flex and Bison"
---

A custom language compiler and parsing engine built from scratch, demonstrating low-level systems engineering, formal grammar validation and memory-safe execution. Built for the Language Processors course (Procesadores del Lenguaje, 2025-26) of the Computer Science and Mathematics double degree at the University of Granada.

[View source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/custom-language-compiler){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## Systems highlights

- **Lexical and syntactic analysis**: a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) pipeline that tokenizes raw input and validates complex grammar rules under strict time and memory constraints.
- **AST construction and traversal**: an abstract syntax tree that manages hierarchical execution logic, with strict C++ memory management to prevent leaks during recursive traversal and node evaluation.
- **Correctness**: handles edge cases, syntax errors and ambiguous grammar gracefully, for predictable and deterministic behavior.

## Why it is relevant to quant work

Less directly finance, but it is the strongest evidence of low-level rigor: careful memory management, deterministic behavior and correctness under constraints. That discipline matters wherever the performance and correctness of numerical pipelines are on the line.

## Tech

C/C++, Flex (lexical analyzer), Bison (syntax analyzer).
